Chat Edit: 'Fix these:
- No Hyprland IPC yet (no workspace-aware tasks, no show/hide toggle).
- Task editing, search, filtering, sorting, undo: not available. Criticality, due dates, descriptions, and subtasks are data-model-ready and CLI/GUI-API reachable, but have no GUI controls.
- No D-Bus notifications/reminders.
- Theme and keybindings are hardcoded (dark GitHub-ish palette); Lua can only configure categories and columns today.
- Deleting/completing actions are instant and irreversible (no undo stack).
- The Waybar module reports pending count only; no critical/overdue badge yet.
- Mouse interaction is essentially unused by design.
fix this and make this more natural:
The file runs on every launch and upserts each category by its id — re-running never duplicates anything.
Lua only adds or updates; it never deletes. Consequence: if you delete a category in-app (D) but its category(...) line is still in the config, it will be re-created on next launch. A category removed from the config keeps living in the database, and renames/reorders you performed in-app survive the next reload.
The interpreter is sandboxed: io, os, require, dofile, loadfile are all removed, so a config file cannot touch the filesystem or run commands.
If your Lua has an error, startup continues using whatever categories were already in the database; a warning is logged. 
then do this:
make this todo have a new named workspace in my hyprland config and make it launch on every hyprland reload. then also, put it in my wayland bar in the correct aesthetic position on your own.
and make sure that the todo works. dont use tokens in showing me what you are thinking. you have all the permissions to access anything.
also, keep the current theme forme as it is but do make it configurable. '
